name: chest-counter
description: Fortnite chest counter overlay: live counting by sound, exact count from replays, treasure hunt stats (unofficial fan tool)
author: basspunks

scripts.replay-reader: dotnet publish replay-reader/src -c Release -o replay-reader/bin -v q -nologo
scripts.replay-reader:exe: dotnet publish replay-reader/src -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true -p:EnableCompressionInSingleFile=true -o replay-reader/bin-exe -v q -nologo
scripts.dist: tsc && npm run replay-reader:exe && electron-builder --win portable --publish never
scripts.release: tsc && npm run replay-reader:exe && electron-builder --win portable --publish always
